title: Databases: Cloud SQL, Spanner, Firestore, and Bigtable — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces transactional commit lifecycle in Cloud Spanner: from client write across distributed Paxos consensus leader and TrueTime atomic timestamping.
routing_rationale: TrueTime uses atomic clocks and GPS receivers to assign globally consistent timestamps, enabling lock-free distributed read transactions across continents.

nodes.label: Spanner Client App
nodes.detail: Initiates read-write transaction to transfer account balances.

nodes.label: Spanner API Gateway
nodes.detail: Routes transaction to the designated Paxos split leader for this keyspace.

nodes.label: Paxos Leader Replica
nodes.detail: Acquires lock; coordinates two-phase commit and requests TrueTime commit timestamp.

nodes.label: Paxos Follower Replica
nodes.detail: Appends transaction log to Colossus storage; votes to accept commit.

nodes.label: TrueTime Atomic Clock
nodes.detail: Guarantees time uncertainty bound (epsilon < 7ms); enforces commit wait.

steps.title: Transaction Routing
steps.action: Client initiates read-write transaction; SDK routes payload directly to Paxos leader.
steps.why_traversal: Direct leader routing minimizes consensus coordination latency.

steps.title: TrueTime Timestamp Assignment
steps.action: Paxos leader requests TrueTime timestamp [t.earliest, t.latest] and enforces commit wait.
steps.why_traversal: Commit wait guarantees past transactions have strictly lower timestamps than future ones.

steps.title: Paxos Quorum Consensus
steps.action: Leader writes mutation log to majority quorum of replicas before committing.
steps.why_traversal: Paxos consensus guarantees data survival even if an entire availability zone disappears.

scenarios.label: Paxos Leader Zone Isolation
scenarios.root_cause: Network partition isolates Zone A leader from remaining 2 zones.
scenarios.diverted_path: Follower replicas in Zone B and C elect new leader in <3 seconds without data loss.
scenarios.blast_radius: In-flight uncommitted transaction retried by SDK on new leader.
scenarios.recovery: TrueTime and Paxos ensure strict serializability is maintained across failovers.
